text: Three adults from Leeba View, vomiting since this afternoon. They all ate fat cook and mala from the same vendor at the taxi rank.
Four children in Nonyana Flats with diarrhoea since yesterday. They ate magwinya and mogodu at a stokvel on Sunday.
Two adults from Thaga Park with vomiting and malaise since last night. They had lamb chops at a friend's house, the same thing as the day before.
